malha-arcana.settings.applyToNPCs.name: Apply to NPCs
malha-arcana.settings.applyToNPCs.hint: If enabled, the Arcane Weave system also applies to NPC spellcasters.
malha-arcana.settings.corruptionResource: Exact name of the custom resource on the character sheet used to track Corruption.
malha-arcana.settings.backlashDamageType: The damage type caused by failed spellcasting (force or psychic).
malha-arcana.settings.showNarrativeFlavo: Shows class-themed flavor text when spellcasting fails.
If enabled, backlash damage is automatically applied to the character's HP.
malha-arcana.settings.autoIncrementCorru: If enabled, Corruption increases by +1 automatically when casting spells of 1st level or higher.
malha-arcana.settings.onlyFirstAttackChe: Test Weave Only on First Attack
If active, multi-attack spells only suffer a Weave check (and rupture risk) on the first attack.
malha-arcana.settings.backlashDieTier1.h: Die size for spell levels 1-3 (e.g. 4 for 1d4).
malha-arcana.settings.backlashDieTier2.h: Die size for spell levels 4-6 (e.g. 6 for 1d6).
malha-arcana.settings.backlashDieTier3.h: Die size for spell levels 7-9 (e.g. 8 for 1d8).
malha-arcana.purge.name: Action: Purge the Weave
malha-arcana.purge.description: You sacrifice your Action in combat to stabilize your own aura, channeling the corrupted energy back into the Arcane Weave. Your Corruption is reduced by 1 point.
malha-arcana.roll.attackPrompt: Roll the attack for {name}! The result will serve for both the AC and the Arcane Weave DC.
malha-arcana.check.title: Arcane Weave Check
malha-arcana.check.failure: Failure! The spell fizzles and the energy rebounds!
malha-arcana.backlash.title: Backlash Damage
malha-arcana.cantrip.title: Safe Cantrip
malha-arcana.cantrip.info: Cantrips do not require an Arcane Weave check and do not generate Corruption.
malha-arcana.corruption.label: Current Corruption
malha-arcana.ruptura.title: ARCANE RUPTURE
malha-arcana.ruptura.01_05.title: Chromatic Distortion
malha-arcana.ruptura.01_05.desc: Your vision inverts into negative colors for 1 minute. Every creature looks like a shadow silhouette; all fire looks ice-blue. Disadvantage on Perception checks based on sight.
malha-arcana.ruptura.06_10.title: Temporal Echo
malha-arcana.ruptura.06_10.desc: You hear your own screams from the future echoing in the past. For 1 minute, you have disadvantage on Initiative checks and cannot be surprised (your future screamed the warning).
malha-arcana.ruptura.11_15.title: Arcane Scent
malha-arcana.ruptura.11_15.desc: You smell magic. Every caster in a 60ft radius exudes an unbearable metallic odor for 10 minutes. Disadvantage on Concentration checks due to nausea.
malha-arcana.ruptura.16_20.title: Whispers of the Weave
malha-arcana.ruptura.16_20.desc: Incomprehensible voices whisper arcane formulas in your ear for 1d4 rounds. While it lasts, you have advantage on Arcana checks, but disadvantage on Wisdom checks.
malha-arcana.ruptura.21_25.title: Sensory Paralysis
malha-arcana.ruptura.21_25.desc: Your senses shut down for an instant: you are blinded and deafened until the start of your next turn. Then, your perception returns with supernatural clarity (advantage on next Perception check).
malha-arcana.ruptura.26_30.title: Arcane Blindness
malha-arcana.ruptura.26_30.desc: Your eyes are covered by a film of bluish energy. You are blinded for 1d4 rounds. No saving throw.
malha-arcana.ruptura.31_35.title: Involuntary Silence
malha-arcana.ruptura.31_35.desc: Your voice is torn by the weave. You are unable to speak or cast spells with a verbal component for 1 minute.
malha-arcana.ruptura.36_40.title: Numb Hands
malha-arcana.ruptura.36_40.desc: Your hands go numb and tremble. You drop what you were holding and have disadvantage on attack rolls and checks with your hands for 1d4 rounds.
malha-arcana.ruptura.41_45.title: Personal Gravity
malha-arcana.ruptura.41_45.desc: Gravity doubles around you. Your speed is halved and you cannot jump for 1 minute.
malha-arcana.ruptura.46_50.title: Arcane Amnesia
malha-arcana.ruptura.46_50.desc: Your mind flashes white. You forget one random prepared spell (or a spell slot is consumed). The memory returns after a short rest.
malha-arcana.ruptura.51_55.title: Arcane Detonation
malha-arcana.ruptura.51_55.desc: The spell explodes in a 10ft radius centered on you. All creatures in the area (including allies) make a DC 14 Dexterity save or take 3d6 force damage.
malha-arcana.ruptura.56_60.title: Psychic Shockwave
malha-arcana.ruptura.56_60.desc: A wave of mental energy emanates from you in a 20ft radius. All creatures in the area make a DC 13 Wisdom save or are stunned until the end of their next turn.
malha-arcana.ruptura.61_65.title: Phantom Flames
malha-arcana.ruptura.61_65.desc: Violet flames erupt from your skin. You and each adjacent creature take 2d8 fire damage. Unworn flammable objects catch fire.
malha-arcana.ruptura.66_70.title: Gravitational Implosion
malha-arcana.ruptura.66_70.desc: Space collapses around you. Each creature within 15ft is pulled into your space and takes 2d10 force damage. Large or larger creatures make a DC 15 Strength save to resist.
malha-arcana.ruptura.71_75.title: Static Storm
malha-arcana.ruptura.71_75.desc: Uncontrolled lightning shoots from your hands hitting 1d4 random targets (allies or enemies) within 30ft, dealing 3d8 lightning damage each.
malha-arcana.ruptura.76_80.title: Minor Rift
malha-arcana.ruptura.76_80.desc: A dimensional rift opens for 1 round. An amorphous tentacle emerges and attacks the nearest creature (including you) with +7 to hit, dealing 3d10 necrotic damage.
malha-arcana.ruptura.81_85.title: Arcane Aging
malha-arcana.ruptura.81_85.desc: The energy of time distorts your body. You age 1d10 years instantly. This aging is real and can only be reversed by Greater Restoration or Wish.
malha-arcana.ruptura.86_90.title: Hostile Summon
malha-arcana.ruptura.86_90.desc: An aberrant creature is summoned at random (DM chooses, CR ≤ spell level). It is hostile to EVERYONE and remains for 1d4 rounds.
malha-arcana.ruptura.91_95.title: Mark of the Abyss
malha-arcana.ruptura.91_95.desc: A dark mark appears on your skin. For 24 hours, extraplanar creatures have advantage on attacks against you and you have disadvantage on saving throws against their effects.
malha-arcana.ruptura.96_97.title: Vital Collapse
malha-arcana.ruptura.96_97.desc: The arcane weave drains all your vital force. You drop to 0 HP immediately and start making death saving throws. Your allies feel a supernatural cold.
malha-arcana.ruptura.98_99.title: Arcane Erasure
malha-arcana.ruptura.98_99.desc: All your prepared spells (or remaining spell slots) are lost. Your connection to the weave has been burned — you cannot cast spells until you finish a long rest.
malha-arcana.ruptura.100.title: Planar Possession
malha-arcana.ruptura.100.desc: An entity from the Far Realm tries to possess your body. Make a DC 18 Charisma saving throw. Failure: you are possessed for 1d4 hours (DM controls your character). Success: the entity is expelled but you take 6d10 psychic damage.
malha-arcana.flavor.warlock: The Patron laughs with disdain as corrupted energy tears your flesh. The bargain takes its toll.
malha-arcana.flavor.cleric: Divine silence echoes as sacred energy turns against you. The gods disapprove.
malha-arcana.flavor.wizard: Your mind bleeds. Arcane equations collapse and pain pierces your consciousness like shattered glass.
malha-arcana.flavor.sorcerer: The wild power in your blood rebels, convulsing your magical essence from within.
malha-arcana.flavor.druid: Nature rejects your attempt. Roots of energy spike under your skin and sap burns like acid.
malha-arcana.flavor.bard: The arcane melody detunes violently. The distorted sound reverberates in your bones like inner thunder.
malha-arcana.flavor.paladin: The oath snaps like broken chains. Divine light burns from within, punishing the lapse in faith.
malha-arcana.flavor.ranger: The connection with the natural world breaks momentarily. Primal energy escapes like a wild fire.
malha-arcana.flavor.artificer: The arcane mechanism fails catastrophically. Sparks and energy fragments cut your skin like metal shrapnel.
malha-arcana.flavor.default: Arcane energy turns against the caster, tearing them from the inside out.
malha-arcana.purge.chat.title: Purge the Weave
malha-arcana.firstrun: Malha Arcana activated! Set up the 'Corruption' resource on player sheets and distribute the 'Action: Purge the Weave' class feature.
